forks.V1: The vintage is the one in force on the date of the event the rule turns on (accident, offer, notice, year), not a contract's conclusion date; moot in outcome.
forks.V2: 'Trước ngày D' is strictly before D (the decree writes 'chậm nhất là ngày D' where D is included).
forks.V3: 'năm tài chính' (financial year) is an input; Article 75(2)(a)'s data period is the calendar year.
forks.V4: Article 75(10): the window is the 15 calendar days before the end date (end - 15 to end - 1).
forks.V5: Working days: Monday to Friday less the caller's days off; the anchor day is not counted (row VN-10's F14, F22).
forks.V6: Article 17(1)(a): 'tử vong và tỷ lệ tổn thương từ 81% trở lên' is two cases.
forks.V7: Article 17(1)(a): the injured person's-intent exception limits the Article 7(2) case only.
forks.V8: Several vehicles: the person is in a case if any vehicle puts the harm in one.
forks.V9: The injury rate is the assessed rate, an input; no assessor is named for the Fund.
forks.V10: 'không thuộc phạm vi bảo hiểm' is read of the person's harm.
forks.V11: The Fund repays the amount advanced up to Article 12(3)(b)'s figure, for every Article 7(2) exclusion.
forks.V12: The base of the ceilings is the year's contributions (plus the balance where the point says so), not interest or sponsorship.
forks.V13: Article 17(1)(i): one total ceiling, the rates of (d)-(h) of a 1% contribution.
forks.V14: Article 75(1) with 8(2): an adjustment on an Article 8(2) ground within 15% is not a discount; any other reduction is.
forks.V15: Article 75(1) binds the insurer and the compulsory cover only.
forks.V16: Article 75(5)'s 'số tiền bảo hiểm tối thiểu' is, for motor, the limit of liability (Article 4(3) pairs them).
forks.V17: Articles 18(2), 21(1)(b): the Executive Board sends; Article 18(2)'s date governs the sending only.
forks.V18: Article 16(1)-(2): the insurer owes the Council's rate, capped at 1%; above 1% is a defect in the facts.
forks.V19: Article 75(10): both the buyer and the insured are notified.
forks.V20: Article 62(5): the police provide, to the insurer, from the day of the investigation result.
forks.V21: Article 16(3)(b): the remainder is the total less the first payment; nothing if the first was the whole.
forks.V22: 'ngay sau khi phê duyệt': no period invented.
forks.V23: Article 75(3): continuous operation; every call recorded.
forks.V24: Article 17(1)(a): a support file is paid whole or carried whole.
forks.LAW: L1-L6 (NOTES.md section 3): payment in 15 days from a complete file (Law Art 31(1)); 1-year claim limit, for contract claims (Art 30(1)); the insurer's duty to explain (Art 20(2)(b)); the Fund's statutory basis (Art 89(3)); no refusal to sell (Art 8(4)); contra proferentem (Art 24). None encoded; the Law is cited in its 2022 text, which Law 139/2025/QH15 amends (Decree 220 preamble).
